auth_ticket_note: Over the gateway the SnapStream session comes from the bearer token's client_id claim, so every caller runs as the one mapped API user. A caller-supplied authTicket is always removed. Methods marked auth_ticket 'empty_object' (permission depends on the input properties) are sent with "authTicket": {} because the gateway inspector throws without it on builds before the fix (SNAPSTREAM_MCP_EMPTY_AUTH_TICKET, default on); every other method omits it.

services.name: Authentication Manager

Gateway integrations don't need this service for ordinary calls, see Authentication, but it's available if you need a ticket for a specific SnapStream user rather than the one your client_id auto-resolves to.

methods.name: EndSession
methods.summary: Closes a file access session.
methods.access_reason: Not exposed by the gateway per the OpenAPI spec. Closes a raw file access session; only meaningful with the blocked session methods.

methods.name: Exists
methods.summary: Checks whether a file or directory exists on the server.
methods.access_reason: Not exposed by the gateway per the OpenAPI spec. Checks whether a server path exists; no side effects.

methods.name: GetLength
methods.summary: Gets the length of a file.
methods.access_reason: Not exposed by the gateway per the OpenAPI spec. Returns a file length; no side effects.

methods.name: OpenReadStream
methods.summary: Enables read operations on the given session.
methods.access_reason: Not exposed by the gateway per the OpenAPI spec. Allocates a byte stream on a file session; raw stream plumbing with no JSON-usable output.

methods.name: StartSession
methods.summary: Starts a file access session.
methods.access_reason: Not exposed by the gateway per the OpenAPI spec. Allocates a server-side file handle and accepts a write accessMode; raw file stream plumbing.
methods.note: Tenant tickets may only open with accessMode=Read; write access requires the internal ServiceNode permission.

methods.name: StartSessionWithShareMode
methods.summary: Starts a file access session with an explicit share mode.
methods.access_reason: Not exposed by the gateway per the OpenAPI spec. Same as StartSession with a share mode; allocates a file handle, raw stream plumbing.
methods.note: Tenant tickets may only open with accessMode=Read; write access requires the internal ServiceNode permission.
